messages.subject: Global Executive Profile | ESG, External Affairs, Government Relations & Industrial Leadership
messages.body:
Dear Cornerstone International Group Team,

Your global executive-search network and cross-border leadership reach make this a focused introduction. I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership responsibilities across government and regulatory relations, ESG and social performance, corporate and external affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships and executive communications. I am pursuing Director, VP, Country and Regional mandates across mining, energy, infrastructure and major industrial investment. Saudi Arabia and the UAE are priority markets, and I am internationally mobile.

My executive CV is attached for confidential consideration and referral to the most relevant partner or regional practice.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
